name: folder-agent
description: Hides AI agent instruction files from the file explorer and marks their folders with an icon.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && bun esbuild.config.mjs production && bun build-release.mjs
scripts.release: bun run lint && bun run build
scripts.version: bun version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
